geological_strata.bedrock_classification: Badenoch Group metamorphic psammite and pelite overlain by Scottish Highland fluvioglacial sands and gravels
geological_strata.foundation_bedding: Granular glacial outwash till with alluvial topsoil matrix
geological_strata.ground_plane: Compacted unpaved farm access tracks, crushed granite aggregate, unpaved dirt aprons, and uneven pasture turf

agricultural_steading_complex.rectification_protocol: Plumb distorted photogrammetric walls, straighten corrugated barn gables, planarize low-pitched shed roofing planes
agricultural_steading_complex.masonry: Traditional Highland whinstone and granite rubble walling with lime mortar pointing on farmhouse, corrugated iron sheeting and timber cladding on steading barns
agricultural_steading_complex.roofing_material: Scottish slate tiles on traditional cottage structures, oxidized corrugated profile metal sheeting on modern agricultural storage units
agricultural_steading_complex.fenestration: Small rectangular sash-and-case timber windows with painted white reveals on dwelling, large open-bay portal frames and sliding agricultural timber doors on barns

landscape_ecology.flora_classification: Scottish Highlands moorland edge pasture, patchy heather (Calluna vulgaris), bracken, creeping thistles, rough grazing grassland
landscape_ecology.woodland_edge: Scattered native Scots pine (Pinus sylvestris) and silver birch (Betula pendula) copses along distant field boundaries
landscape_ecology.topography: Undulating Speyside valley floor leading northwest towards low rounded Monadhliath ridges in the far distance

lighting_and_atmosphere.atmospheric_optics: Low-angle golden autumnal sunlight raking across the Spey valley floor, casting long soft-edged directional shadows northeast, light autumn ground haze in mountain distance
